an adaptive PID controller with fuzzy gain scheduling is proposed for fault tolerant control of a quadcopter in the presence of faults in all actuators, and the proposed method is experimentally applied to a quadrotors testbed.

the proposed adaptive PID controller can be effectively used for the fault-tolerant flight control of a quadcopter in the event of loss of control effectiveness of all actuators and in the event of failure of a single actuator.
an adaptive fuzzy gain-scheduled PID controller is proposed and applied to a quadrotors helicopter testbed for fault-toleration of actuator faults in real-time.

the development and implementation of fault tolerant flight control system (FTFCS) for quadrotor helicopter.
the problem of fault tolerant flight control of a quad-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) in the presence of faults.
the development of an adaptive fault-tolerant controller for a quadrotor testbed.

the proposed fault-tolerant fuzzy PID controller is able to handle the actuator fault scenarios and provide a good level of performance.
the proposed method is a promising alternative to conventional fault-tolerant controllers for quadrotor helicopters.
the proposed method is effective and robust in the event of faults in the actuator system of a quadrotors.

a fuzzy gain-scheduled PID controller can be effectively used for fault-toleration of a quadrotop helicopter in the presence of control actuator faults.

the adaptive PID controller can be used as a fault-tolerant scheme to improve the robustness of a system in the event of actuator faults.
